traits.desc: A creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 hrs after infection: fatigue light-headedness and blurry vision. When infected creature casts a spell or activates a magic item itchy rash appears and spreads as more magic is used. Until disease is cured when infected creature starts its turn wielding or wearing magic item and each time it casts a spell or activates a magic item it loses 5 (2d4) hp. At end of each long rest infected creature must make a DC 13 Con save. Fail: hp the creature loses each time it uses magic increases by 2 (1d4). A creature that makes 3 saves recovers.

ru.description: Крупная аберрация, мировоззрение: хаотично-злое. Класс доспеха: 12. Хиты: 105 (14к10+28). Скорость: ходьба 50 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 18, ЛОВ 14, ТЕЛ 15, ИНТ 11, МУД 17, ХАР 16.
